entries.headline: JANET01 Beech B200C sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a spotter report identifying a Janet Beech B200C Super King Air using call sign JANET01, registration N661BA and hex code A8B80A, in a pattern at 15,000 feet. The visible source text gives an uncertain origin and is truncated after “10 k SW of,” so the location is not stated; the sighting was credited to alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: Iraqi airspace corridor restrictions report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a NOTAM report saying Iraq had restricted flights over its airspace and into four major airports to designated corridors from 05:00 to 11:00 UTC daily. The visible source text is truncated after “daily” and does not show the remainder; the item was credited to angrymusicsupers.

entries.headline: Coded U.S. Air Force radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a worldwide increase in coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts, with the highest activity in the eastern Mediterranean and the United States, and said detected volume was nearly four times normal.

entries.headline: WATCH30 E-3G Sentry sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a spotter report identifying a Boeing E-3G Sentry using call sign WATCH30, registration 82-0006 and hex code AE11EF. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: FH-95 combat drone shootdown report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that the Sudanese Armed Forces had shot down another UAE-operated FH-95, also identified as a CH-95, unmanned combat aerial vehicle used by the UAE-backed Rapid Support Forces. The visible source text is truncated after “Forces” and does not show the remainder; the item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: VENUS51 C-40B sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a spotter report identifying a Boeing C-40B using call sign VENUS51, registration 01-0015 and hex code AE115D. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Iraqi airport NOTAM report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that Iraq had issued a NOTAM concerning overflights and aircraft landing at Baghdad, Erbil, Sulaimaniyah and Kirkuk. The visible source text is truncated after “Kirkuk” and does not show the full requirement; the item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: E-3 Sentry sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a spotter report identifying an E-3 Sentry with hex code AE11EA. No call sign or registration was listed, and the sighting was credited to neeshbruh.

entries.headline: NATO anti-drone platform report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an Insider Paper report that NATO had launched a platform intended to help member states strengthen anti-drone defences. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: South Korean Strait of Hormuz deployment report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that South Korea had announced a military deployment off East Africa toward the Strait of Hormuz despite Iranian warnings. The visible source text is truncated after mentioning resistance to U.S. pressure and does not show the remainder; the item was credited to neesh26.

entries.headline: EDDIE61 KC-135 sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a spotter report identifying a U.S. Air Force KC-135 using call sign EDDIE61, registration 59-1458 and hex code AE0384, departing Columbus, Ohio and heading east toward the Atlantic. The sighting was credited to alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: Paraguay president resignation report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Associated Press report saying Paraguay President Santiago Peña had resigned after the collapse of Ueno Bank. War Watch said the report was subsequently confirmed by two outlets.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: NASA806 U-2 movement reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported NASA806, described as a U-2, at about 60,000 feet and heading eastward.

entries.headline: Business-jet activity and growth leaders reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that over the 13 weeks to 1 November, the Phenom 300 accounted for 9.4% of tracked business-jet activity, the Latitude 7.1% and the XLS 6.1%. Among aircraft types with at least a 1% share, it said the G650 grew 17.3% and the Falcon 2000 grew 15.8% when comparing the latest four weeks with the first four, while activity across all types rose 8.0%.

entries.headline: SCORE90 Global Hawk sighting reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported tracking SCORE90, a Northrop Grumman Global Hawk (Q4), off the Mid-Atlantic coast. It said the aircraft was spotted at about 49,900 feet at 2:44 p.m. ET on 3 November and last seen around 3:01 p.m. about nine miles east-southeast of Ocean City, Maryland.

entries.headline: NTSB weather focus in Sunday crash relayed
entries.summary: SkyGlass relayed comments from its founder about air-traffic-control audio from Sunday's crash and said the audio would not be shared out of respect. It reported that the NTSB was focusing on weather and offered condolences to those affected.

entries.headline: NetJets and Flexjet activity growth reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported tracked NetJets and Flexjet activity up 11.0% in October 2026 from October 2025, while full-service Jet A rose from $7.50 to $7.86. It said fractional flying did not slow and that the figures were pulled with the SkyGlass MCP.

entries.headline: N722BD Learjet 60 crash reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Learjet 60 N722BD, flying from Austin to North Eleuthera, crashed near Military Trail in Palm Beach County on Sunday afternoon, killing all nine people aboard. It said the NTSB was investigating and shared an AVIAR Labs Overwatch replay.

entries.headline: Signature Access FBO pricing changes examined
entries.summary: SkyGlass said Signature Access prices core fixed-base-operator access by aircraft size, ramp time and location, while limiting event fees from 2027. It argued that ramp dwell time and demand are operational variables FBOs should track, citing RampWatch as a way to show them.

entries.headline: BACE2026 four-field business-jet total revisited
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that 1,040 distinct business jets moved through four Las Vegas fields during BACE2026 show week. It said the RampWatch board prompted conversations, including direct-message feedback that ramp personnel wanted views of their own traffic, and linked to a replay.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.
